items.title: Meta spend 2026-10-13 to 10-19: $347.55, 16 leads, CPL $21.72
items.summary: Flooring Problems Campaign was the only campaign with spend: $347.55, 9,330 impressions, 257 clicks, 16 leads. Account ACTIVE, no disapproved ads.

needs_attention: No prior meta-ads.json in the last 7 days (latest was 2026-09-08), so this run covers 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-19 as one 7-day window, not a single day. Spend and leads are weekly totals.
No daily baseline comparison was possible on a 7-day aggregate; no anomalies detected (CPL $21.72, account CAD).
